rules.name: Verified problem identity
rules.reason: Full user supplied statement cross-checked against retrieved organizer catalogue on 9 September 2026. Initial SIH2171 shorthand superseded.

rules.name: Six-person delivery ceiling
rules.reason: Architecture and scope docs record one primary journey, ≤2 services (browser client + Node server), ≤1 SQLite audit store, ≤1 optional local Ollama provider. No custom training or specialized hardware required for the candidate. Evidence: Docs/architecture.md, Docs/scope.md.

rules.name: Reproducible complete workflow
rules.reason: Chromium MV3 load/inject/reach evidenced (extension-native-v03). Wave2–4 prove production scripting inject + collect, activeTab capture gate, popup protect loop, privacy-only skip-LLM path, and judge/demo checklist for human toolbar. Toolbar glyph automation, Firefox live run, and full clean-setup-to-reload e2e.json remain open — status stays unknown.

rules.name: Evidence-backed differentiation
rules.reason: Wiki/competitors.md compares ≥5 adjacent solutions. Implemented differentiator (pixel-free egress + selective local preview + expiring references) demonstrated against full-image mask baseline via held-out fixtures and extension sanitize evidence. No first/unique global claims. Evidence: Benchmarks/results/differentiation.json.

rules.name: Prototype capacity floor
rules.reason: Implementation/validation in progress for verified SIH26171; no completion asserted.

rules.name: Validated requests and safe output
rules.reason: Server Zod schema validation, auth/origin allowlist, body size and rate limits covered by Prototype unit tests; client assertSanitizedPayload + capture-loop forbid screenshot/pixel/URL fields before network; Wave3 security.json records 0 high secret-scan findings and cites harness sanitize evidence. Malformed payloads return controlled errors in unit coverage. Scope: local prototype, not multi-tenant production.

rules.name: Access and data boundaries
rules.reason: Public demo and fixtures are explicitly synthetic; audit SQLite stores counts/timings only (no screen/prompt/token); .env and Prototype/data/ gitignored; Wave3 security scan found 0 high-severity secrets in tracked sources; pairing token is local session/file mode 0600 and not committed. Cross-user multi-tenant auth is out of current single-operator local scope.

rules.reason: dependency-audit.json present (0 critical/high on omit=dev audit this wave). Secret scan clean. Public GitHub Pages is static-only; Node prototype deployment controls (HTTPS reverse proxy, CSRF for cookie auth, production hardening) remain incomplete — status stays unknown.
